environment.materials: Five independent shipped sales orders and invoice requests created by tests/invoice-task-workspace.integration.mjs

replication.notes: RISEMAP current page is empty; header, periods, metrics, statuses, columns and empty state are observed, while row actions and same-material outcomes remain unavailable.

visual.notes: Populated desktop plus 390x844 narrow first screen, status filtering, search, empty result, reset and issuance dialog were checked in the built-in browser. Independent visual review remains pending.

interaction.notes: Forge approval, rejection, issuance, search, reset and required-field blocking passed. RISEMAP row-level behavior remains unavailable with the current empty account.

business.notes: Forge invoice and receivable creation plus same-SQLite restart readback passed. RISEMAP same-material business outcome remains unavailable.

requirements.expected: Metrics and rows follow the selected period.
requirements.observed: Tabs work; all current material falls in the same period, so cross-period differentiation remains pending.

requirements.steps: Approve and issue records while reading metrics.
requirements.expected: Only approved records contribute to pending count and amount.

requirements.steps: Switch status tabs before and after actions.
requirements.expected: Rows filter while period metrics remain stable.
requirements.observed: Pending, approved and all tabs returned the expected rows.

requirements.expected: One matching row, then the full list.
Ten columns use actual related and audit fields.
requirements.observed: Order, customer, tax, applicant and submitted time resolved correctly.

requirements.steps: Operate every Forge status and compare RISEMAP.
requirements.expected: Actions follow status and both products have understood outcomes.
requirements.observed: Forge passed; RISEMAP row behavior remains unavailable.

requirements.steps: Submit missing inputs and wrong-state actions.
requirements.expected: Clear blocking with no unintended transition.

requirements.steps: Check desktop and 390x844 built-in-browser views, including status tabs, search, empty result, reset and issuance dialog.
requirements.expected: Usable first screen without page-level horizontal overflow; wide table scrolls only inside its card.
requirements.observed: Desktop and narrow views passed. Period scope, metrics, filters and dialog remained usable without overlap; the wide table stayed inside its scroll container.

requirements.steps: Issue from the page, read invoice and receivable, restart, and read again.
requirements.expected: Linked issued invoice and unpaid receivable survive restart.
requirements.observed: Invoice and receivable remained linked at 26000 after restart.
